load_raw_volume: load a raw 3D volume from a .npy or binary file with optional cropping and downsampling
crop_hair_by_density: crop hair regions from volumetric data using a specified hair density range threshold
load_bin_strands: load hair strand data from a binary file containing vertex positions and normal vectors
save_bin_strands: save hair strand data with optional tangent vectors to a binary file format
expand_vidx: expand voxel indices by a scale rate to generate finer-grained 3D coordinate grids
